_about: W. S. Browning, A History of the Huguenots, third edition, continued to the present time (London: Whittaker, 1842): his History of the Huguenots during the Sixteenth Century (1829) and its continuation to 1838, revised in one volume. Named w-s-browning so the poet cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
